summary: Polls stats.example.com every 1h for Monthly recurring revenue, Active users.

fill.id: A name for the feed, lower case, digits and hyphens. The pack is feed-<id> and its poll feed_<id>, cut to 32 characters.
fill.url: The whole https:// address that answers the numbers as JSON, written out and never computed. Its host is what the owner approves.
fill.every: How often it is asked. 1h for numbers that move within a day, 1d for numbers that do not.
fill.grant: The label of the key in the vault, which the request sends as a bearer token. A label and never the key itself. Leave it out for an address that answers anybody.
fill.project: The project the numbers are about, as its row id or spoken id (things#1), so each reading lands on it. Optional.
fill.organisation: The organisation the numbers are about, as its row id or spoken id (organisations#1). Optional, and only for a readings list that has an organisation field.
fill.measures: Each number and where it is in the answer: a name as the Dashboard shows it, a path (data.mrr), a unit (USD, users) and int when a fraction is wrong. One map each, twenty at most, no name twice.

author: BrainDog
